items.title: Charlie Hardy Interview, 1961-12-16
items.q: Oh, yes, I've heard Ted Lewis in the past.

ctx.x: Uh-huh. Uh, after the success of the original Dixieland jazz band, there were several bands that represented themselves. As, uh, the original Dixieland jazz band. Well, not necessarily using the name, because maybe that was protected legally, I'm not sure. But, uh, there were several that represented themselves as being New Orleans-style bands. Uh-huh. Did you have a chance to hear anybody like Ted Lewis, or, uh...
Oh, yes, I've heard Ted Lewis in the past.
Or emphasize in the same period?
